title: Lithic header
description: A plain white top bar: bold caps wordmark, four medium-weight nav links beside it, a quiet text link and a small dark pill on the right. On phones the links fold into a burger that drops a full-width panel (no JavaScript: a details disclosure).
notes: 65px tall on desktop, 72px on phones; not sticky, as the original
name: lithic-header

props.name: wordmark
props.description: the company name, set as a bold caps wordmark

props.name: mark
props.description: a small mark before the wordmark (e.g. a lucide icon)

props.name: links
props.description: the main links, beside the wordmark on desktop

props.name: secondary
props.description: the quiet text link on the right ("Contact us")

props.name: action
props.description: the dark pill on the right ("Dashboard")
